text:
maria: heads-up from canary run: encrypted safetensors + parallel prefetch blew our KMS quota. nodes hit throttling when fetching many small shards concurrently.

ajay: one KMS call per shard unwrap today?
maria: yep. each shard header stores wrapped DEK, PrefetchWorker does KMS:Decrypt per header. works fine for big shards but tiny-shard workloads explode QPS.
lily: short-term: staggered prefetch or soft rate limit?
maria: soft rate limit reduces p95 warmup. need protocol change. two paths: session-per-bundle (single KMS unwrap -> derive per-shard DEKs) or keep per-shard but add a shared RAM cache TTL.
zane: session path sounds best for hosted scale. but HSM customers may forbid caching derived keys even transiently.
samir: hybrid: prefer session when manifest advertises session_supported and registry allows it; fallback to per-shard unwrap otherwise. preserves compatibility.
maria: proposal: manifest v2 add encryption.session object: scheme:kms-session-v1, derive:hkdf-sha256, ttl_seconds. loader tries session unwrap first. on success derive per-shard DEKs locally using shard path as salt. on failure fallback to per-shard unwrap.
kevin: ops/compliance: control plane must be able to flip session_allowed per-customer at bundle publish. registered policy can set STRICT (no session) or ALLOW.
lily: product will default session_allowed=false for Private until compliance attests.
ajay: implementation notes: avoid thundering herd for session unwraps. add PrefetchCoordinator per-node with per-bundle mutex. first prefetcher performs session KMS call, others wait (with bounded timeout + jitter).
maria: also cache derived per-shard DEKs keyed by bundle+shard, TTL tied to session ttl (e.g., 10m) and max_items cap. zeroize keys on eviction.
zane: crypto detail: HKDF(info=bundle_version, salt=shard_path) -> per-shard DEK. include nonce derivation for AES-GCM unique IVs.
samir: question: streaming decrypt straight into GPU to save host memory?
maria: attractive but risky. if integrity check fails mid-stream we need rollback semantics and it complicates eviction. postpone for later.
kevin: extra guard: registry should refuse to mark bundle session_allowed if customer's KMS/HSM policy forbids session caching. control plane stores session_allowed boolean in bundle metadata.
lily: will coordinate. add UI to registry to show session status and audit reason.
ajay: metrics to add: kms.session_unwrap_attempts, kms.session_unwrap_failures, prefetch.session_wait_ms, prefetch.derived_dek_cache_hit, prefetch.per_shard_unwrap_count. expose trace event with path used (session|cache|per-shard).
zane: loader prefetch ordering: prefer shards with warmup_priority (lower=fetch earlier). sort key: (session_available?0:1, warmup_priority, shard_size). add shards[*].warmup_priority field to manifest.
maria: also propose shards[*].enc_hot=true for shards that must be present for low-latency responses so session benefits are applied first.
samir: fallback semantics: loader should obey bundle policy enum: STRICT -> fail on unwrap failures; PERMISSIVE -> attempt unencrypted fallback variant if registry has one; ALLOW_SMALLER_MODEL -> load reduced checkpoint. log audit event.
kevin: make sure KMS errors don't cause retry storms. session unwrap should use exponential backoff with jitter and a coordinator to serialize retries.
maria: test plan: synthetic canary with 300 concurrent prefetches, measure KMS QPS, throttle rates, warmup p95, derived-dek cache hit rates, CPU for AES decryption, and registry session_allowed toggles.
registry-bot: bundle registration event queued: rwd/llama-13b/v4 with session_allowed=false (audit pending).
lily: thanks all. i'll take draft manifest schema and compliance notes to product. maria please drop RFC link once ready.
maria: will do, thanks everyone.
